card.name: Question headings in patient test pages
card.fires_on: The first word of a question-style heading such as "How the test is performed" or "What is this test?" on patient-education test and procedure pages. It also fires on small words inside dosing directions like "once a day in a thin film".

modes.label: Test page headings
modes.description: The opening How, What or Why of a question heading about a lab test or procedure.
modes.example: Iron - serum <<How>> the test is performed: A blood sample

modes.label: Application directions
modes.description: Small words in topical dosing directions, such as in, a, or a number before "to 4 times daily".
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Apply to affected area <<3>> to 4 times daily.
